title.en: Representation-theoretic view — positions as translations and spectra
title.zh: 表示论视角——位置作为平移与谱

en.a: RoPE is a unitary representation of the integer translation group; relative-position attention is an invariant inner product and a finite spectral kernel.
en.b: Position methods differ by the object they modify: RoPE changes the representation, YaRN reshapes its frequency support, and ALiBi/T5 add Toeplitz logit corrections.

zh.a: RoPE 是整数平移群的酉表示；相对位置注意力是不变内积和有限谱核。
zh.b: 位置方法的区别在于它们修改的对象：RoPE 改变表示，YaRN 重塑其频率支撑，而 ALiBi/T5 添加 Toeplitz 对数几率修正。
